svg.title: PautangBai frog mascot spritesheet
svg.desc: Eight original frog mascot states in a 4 by 2 grid of 240 by 240 cells (left to right, top to bottom): welcome, happy, thinking, reminder, offline, syncing, payment, empty. Transparent background.

rdf:Description.dc:title: PautangBai frog mascot spritesheet
rdf:Description.dc:description: Original PautangBai frog mascot, 8 states, 4x2 grid, cell size 240x240, palette from PAUTANGBAI_COLOR_PALETTE.md
rdf:Description.dc:creator: PautangBai

g.title: Frog welcoming and waving
g.desc: Friendly waving frog for onboarding and welcome screens.

g.title: Cheerful frog
g.desc: Happy frog with closed smiling eyes and sparkles for friendly feedback.

g.title: Frog thinking about numbers
g.desc: Frog with a hand at its chin and a thought bubble containing a small bar chart.

g.title: Frog with a gentle reminder bell
g.desc: Frog holding an amber bell as a calm, non-judgmental payment reminder.

g.title: Frog with data saved on this device
g.desc: Frog holding a phone with a check shield, beside a crossed-out cloud: saved locally while offline.

g.title: Frog while data is syncing
g.desc: Frog holding a phone with a progress bar, with circular sync arrows above its head.

g.title: Frog confirming a recorded payment
g.desc: Frog holding a receipt with a success check, next to a small stack of coins.

g.title: Frog with an empty list
g.desc: Frog holding an empty placeholder list for no debtors or no activity yet.
